question: Should CodexBar permanently expose the local Share Stats workflow in both the status menu and Settings?
rationale: The branch is technically strong and already has substantial owner-authored hardening, but it adds prominent long-lived product entry points and the discussion still explicitly requests final product/design acceptance.

options.title: Approve both entry points
options.body: Land the local-only image and text export in the status menu and Settings as proposed.

options.title: Approve a narrower surface
options.body: Keep the export implementation but retain only one entry point or otherwise reduce its prominence before merge.

options.title: Decline sharing
options.body: Close the PR if shareable aggregate artifacts do not fit CodexBar’s intended product scope.

recommendation.title: Approve both entry points
recommendation.body: Land the local-only image and text export in the status menu and Settings as proposed.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the repository, was directly asked for this decision, and authored multiple commits refining this exact feature.
